order: calibration; both arms Base and temporary native admission; U1..8+reload; P1..8+reload; terminal Judge; comparison and public delivery
active: Retain newest active state until all insertion/prefix consumers and two-output exact native reload PASS; then retire active optimizer checkpoint with receipt
native: Retain one current native per arm until completion/comparison review; no per-source archive
old: Preserve old run outputs, costs, receipts and existing native files; never overwrite old root
failure: Preserve failed state and costs, no automatic replay
monitor: every30minutes; quiet unless meaningful failure/completion/user action; pause after terminal handling
